test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Important**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the correct option to be filled in the blank is **Important**. 
 
• **Important:** Something that is necessary or of great value. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Learning English is important nowadays. *
 
 

The complete sentence is: **You make plans the previous day to get your most important task done first thing in the morning, but you don't follow through on them.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Importantly **is used for saying that a fact you are talking about is important.
 
• **Importance** refers to the quality of being important.
 
• **Import** refers to buying or bringing in products from another country.
